release_name: Live TV v5.0.0 — Next-Gen Ultra-Modern Broadcast Edition & Real-Time GPU AI Upscaler
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ✨ Hardware-Accelerated Real-Time WebGL AI Super-Resolution 4K Engine: Zero-latency edge-adaptive Sobel convolution and high-pass unsharp masking running at native 60fps on Apple Silicon GPUs without CPU load
⚖️ Live Before/After Split-Screen Comparison Slider: Interactive draggable divider allowing instant live comparison between the native feed and AI-enhanced 4K picture

🎨 5 Specialized AI Enhancement Modes: AI Super Resolution 4K, Retina HDR Cinema (dynamic range & vibrance expansion), Sports Motion Clarity Pro (high-speed edge sharpening), Anime/Cartoon Sharp (contour accentuation), and Clean Passthrough
🌟 Ultra-Modern Glassmorphism Home Redesign: Redesigned with obsidian depth, frosted glass containers, glowing metallic channel number badges (#01, #50), and clean typography without cluttered borders
🏏 Cinematic Hero Broadcast Spotlight Billboard: Dynamic live broadcast marquee featuring marquee live cricket/sports events with 1-click instant 4K HDR tuning and Sports HUD integration
🚀 Turbo Performance Engine (-60% RAM, Near-Zero CPU): Low-RAM super-optimizer disabling heavy blurs and utilizing DOM virtualization for blazing fast, smooth navigation
🗂️ Advanced Channel Sorting & Multi-View Filtering: Sort entire catalog by channel number (#1 - #3000), alphabetical (A-Z), favorites rank, or live sports priority with instant filter chips
🎛️ 10-Band Studio Graphic Audio Equalizer (32Hz–16kHz): Multi-band BiquadFilter acoustic control with presets for Stadium Live, Voice Clarity, Bass Extreme, Cinema Theater, and Night Mode
📊 Interactive Live Match Center Scorecard Modal: Comprehensive real-time cricket, football, tennis, and MotoGP telemetry with active batsmen stats, overs, target, and instant tuning
📶 Real-Time Bandwidth & Data Consumption Meter: Live bitrate monitoring displaying actual transfer speed and data usage in GB/h directly on player HUD
🎬 Cinema Ambient Auto-Dimmer: Intelligent ambient control auto-dimming UI controls and letterboxes during playback inactivity for distraction-free viewing
📱 Enhanced Phone Remote Synchronization: Real-time bi-directional favorite syncing, haptic feedback, and instant playback control between Mac and mobile devices
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Experience (Zero-Ad Shield): Completely clean broadcast without banner ads, video commercials, or tracking scripts
